shortDescription: Create, update or delete a VM.

options.name: attach_guest_tools_iso
options.description: If supported by operating system, create an extra device to attach the Scale Guest OS tools ISO. Supported by I(operating_system=os_windows_server_2012).

options.name: boot_devices
options.description: Ordered list of boot devices (disks and nics) you want to set

options.name: cloud_init
options.description: Configuration to be used by cloud-init (Linux) or cloudbase-init (Windows). When non-empty will create an extra ISO device attached to VM as a NoCloud datasource. There has to be cloud-config comment present at the beginning of cloud_init file or raw yaml. The cloud-init configuration is applied only during the initial creation of a VM (whether through provisioning, cloning, or importing). It is not applied to an existing VM. This is consistent with the behavior of the HyperCore appliance.

options.name: description
options.description: VM's description. Only relevant if I(state=present). value.

options.name: disks
options.description: List of disks we want to create. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: force_reboot
options.description: Can VM be forced to power off and on. Only used when modifications to the VM require it to be powered off and VM does not respond to a shutdown request within I(shutdown_timeout) limit. Before this is utilized, a shutdown request is sent.

options.name: machine_type
options.description: Scale I(Hardware) version. Required if creating a new VM. Only relevant when creating the VM. This property cannot be modified. HyperCore needs to support requested machine_type. BIOS and UEFI - available since 9.1. vTPM+UEFI - available since 9.2. vTPM+UEFI-compatible - available since 9.3.

options.name: memory
options.description: VM's physical memory in bytes. Required if I(state=present). Irrelevant if I(state=absent).

options.name: nics
options.description: List of network interfaces we want to create. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: operating_system
options.description: Operating system name. Used to select drivers package

options.name: power_state
options.description: Desired VM state. States C(PAUSE) and C(LIVEMIGRATE) are not exposed in this module (this can be done with raw api module). Note that - I(shutdown) will trigger a graceful ACPI shutdown. - I(reboot) will trigger a graceful ACPI reboot. - I(stop) will trigger an abrupt shutdown (force power off). VM might loose data, and filesystem might be corrupted afterwards. - I(reset) will trigger an abrupt reset (force power reset). VM might loose data, and filesystem might be corrupted afterwards.

options.name: shutdown_timeout
options.description: How long does ansible controller wait for VMs response to a shutdown request. In seconds.

options.name: snapshot_schedule
options.description: The name of an existing snapshot_schedule to assign to VM. VM can have 0 or 1 snapshot schedules assigned.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags of the VM. The first tag determines the group that the VM is going to belong.

options.name: vcpu
options.description: Number of Central processing units on the VM. Required if I(state=present). If I(state=absent), vcpu is not relevant.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Virtual machine name. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.

options.name: vm_name_new
options.description: Use it to rename a VM. If the VM already exists, VM's new name. Only relevant if I(state=present).
